comparison.objective: Turn two eggs from lying to small-end-down and place them in carton cups.
comparison.physical_skill: Shape-based orientation, fragile-object reorientation, and tapered-cup placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each egg centred within 4 mm, below cup rim, small-end axis within 20° down, released; both held 1 s. No separate spec version is available.
comparison.reason: This tests fragile reorientation and packing, with no tool impact, material separation, retained component, or debris recovery.
